job_results_fixture.name: job_results_fixture
job_results_fixture.value: coalesce("job_run_results"."result"->>'fixture' = 'infrastructure-only' AND "job_run_results"."result"->>'operation' = 'echo' AND jsonb_typeof("job_run_results"."result"->'message') = 'string' AND length("job_run_results"."result"->>'message') between 1 and 256 AND "job_run_results"."result" - 'fixture' - 'operation' - 'message' = '{}'::jsonb, false)

job_runs_input.name: job_runs_input
job_runs_input.value: coalesce(jsonb_typeof("job_runs"."input") = 'object' AND "job_runs"."input"->>'operation' = 'echo' AND jsonb_typeof("job_runs"."input"->'message') = 'string' AND length("job_runs"."input"->>'message') between 1 and 256 AND "job_runs"."input" - 'operation' - 'message' = '{}'::jsonb, false)

job_runs_error.name: job_runs_error
job_runs_error.value: ("job_runs"."status" = 'failed' AND "job_runs"."error_code" is not null AND "job_runs"."error_details" is not null) OR ("job_runs"."status" <> 'failed' AND "job_runs"."error_code" is null AND "job_runs"."error_details" is null)

catalog_identity.name: catalog_identity
catalog_identity.value: "catalog_versions"."catalog_key" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,79}$' AND "catalog_versions"."version" ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)$' AND length("catalog_versions"."version") <= 40 AND "catalog_versions"."schema_version" IN ('1','2') AND "catalog_versions"."content_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

catalog_body_limit.name: catalog_body_limit
catalog_body_limit.value: octet_length("catalog_versions"."body"::text) between 1 and (CASE WHEN "catalog_versions"."schema_version"='2' THEN 16777216 ELSE 8388608 END)

catalog_real_evidence.name: catalog_real_evidence
catalog_real_evidence.value: coalesce("catalog_versions"."body"->'synthetic' = 'false'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof("catalog_versions"."body"->'profiles') = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof("catalog_versions"."body"->'sources') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("catalog_versions"."body"->'profiles') between 1 and 300 AND jsonb_array_length("catalog_versions"."body"->'sources') between 1 and 600 AND jsonb_array_length(jsonb_path_query_array("catalog_versions"."body", '$.profiles[*] ? (@.synthetic == false)')) = jsonb_array_length("catalog_versions"."body"->'profiles') AND jsonb_array_length(jsonb_path_query_array("catalog_versions"."body", '$.sources[*] ? (@.synthetic == false)')) = jsonb_array_length("catalog_versions"."body"->'sources') AND ("catalog_versions"."schema_version" = '1' OR (jsonb_typeof("catalog_versions"."body"->'issues') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(jsonb_path_query_array("catalog_versions"."body", '$.issues[*] ? (@.synthetic == false)')) = jsonb_array_length("catalog_versions"."body"->'issues'))),false)

plan_owner_expiry.name: plan_owner_expiry
plan_owner_expiry.value: ("plan_owners"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "plan_owners"."token_hash" IS NULL AND "plan_owners"."expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("plan_owners"."user_id" IS NULL AND "plan_owners"."token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "plan_owners"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "plan_owners"."expires_at" > "plan_owners"."created_at" AND "plan_owners"."expires_at" <= "plan_owners"."created_at" + interval '7 days')

plan_parent.name: plan_parent
plan_parent.value: "plan_requests"."parent_plan_id" is null OR ("plan_requests"."parent_plan_id" <> "plan_requests"."id" AND "plan_requests"."input"->>'schema_version'='2' AND "plan_requests"."input"->'what_if' is not null)

plan_expiry.name: plan_expiry
plan_expiry.value: "plan_requests"."expires_at" > "plan_requests"."created_at" AND (("plan_requests"."retention"='guest' AND "plan_requests"."expires_at" <= "plan_requests"."created_at" + interval '1 day') OR ("plan_requests"."retention"='account' AND "plan_requests"."expires_at" <= "plan_requests"."created_at" + interval '365 days'))

plan_evidence.name: plan_evidence
plan_evidence.value: coalesce(jsonb_typeof("plan_requests"."evidence")='object' AND "plan_requests"."evidence"->>'catalogSnapshotId'="plan_requests"."catalog_snapshot_id"::text AND "plan_requests"."evidence"->>'catalogSha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "plan_requests"."evidence"->>'intakeVersion'='1' AND "plan_requests"."evidence"->>'policyVersion'='intake-policy-1' AND "plan_requests"."evidence"->'weatherSnapshotIds'='[]'::jsonb AND "plan_requests"."evidence"->'engineVersion'='null'::jsonb AND "plan_requests"."evidence"->'rankingVersion'='null'::jsonb,false)

plan_error.name: plan_error
plan_error.value: coalesce(("plan_requests"."status"='failed' AND "plan_requests"."error_code" in ('RETRIES_EXHAUSTED','QUEUE_TERMINAL_WITHOUT_RESULT','STORED_REQUEST_INVALID','CATALOG_EVIDENCE_INVALID')) OR ("plan_requests"."status"<>'failed' AND "plan_requests"."error_code" is null),false)

auth_mail_lease.name: auth_mail_lease
auth_mail_lease.value: ("auth_mail"."status"='running') = ("auth_mail"."lease_id" is not null and "auth_mail"."lease_until" is not null)

planning_states.name: planning_states
planning_states.value: ("planning_runs"."status"='queued' AND "planning_runs"."stage"='awaiting_processing') OR ("planning_runs"."status"='running' AND "planning_runs"."stage" in ('verifying_evidence','generating_sequences','retrieving_weather','calculating')) OR ("planning_runs"."status"='completed' AND "planning_runs"."stage"='complete') OR ("planning_runs"."status"='failed' AND "planning_runs"."stage"='failed')

planning_lease.name: planning_lease
planning_lease.value: ("planning_runs"."status"='running') = ("planning_runs"."lease_id" is not null AND "planning_runs"."lease_until" is not null)

planning_result.name: planning_result
planning_result.value: coalesce(("planning_runs"."status"='completed' AND "planning_runs"."result" is not null AND "planning_runs"."result_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "planning_runs"."result"->>'kind'=(CASE "planning_runs"."versions"->>'workflowVersion' WHEN 'planning-workflow-1' THEN 'planning_assessment' ELSE 'rotation_assessment' END) AND octet_length("planning_runs"."result"::text)<=8388608) OR ("planning_runs"."status"<>'completed' AND "planning_runs"."result" is null AND "planning_runs"."result_hash" is null),false)

planning_error.name: planning_error
planning_error.value: coalesce(("planning_runs"."status"='failed' AND "planning_runs"."error_code" in ('STORED_REQUEST_INVALID','CATALOG_EVIDENCE_INVALID','WEATHER_UNAVAILABLE','PLANNING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED','RETRIES_EXHAUSTED','QUEUE_TERMINAL_WITHOUT_RESULT','WORKFLOW_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED','CALCULATION_FAILED')) OR ("planning_runs"."status"<>'failed' AND "planning_runs"."error_code" is null),false)

climate_scenario_tile_state.name: climate_scenario_tile_state
climate_scenario_tile_state.value: "climate_scenario_tiles"."status" in ('requested','preparing','ready','failed') AND "climate_scenario_tiles"."units_ready" between 0 and "climate_scenario_tiles"."units_total" AND "climate_scenario_tiles"."units_total" between 1 and 20000 AND "climate_scenario_tiles"."failures" between 0 and 1000 AND ("climate_scenario_tiles"."status"='ready') = ("climate_scenario_tiles"."completed_at" is not null) AND ("climate_scenario_tiles"."status"='failed') = ("climate_scenario_tiles"."error_code" is not null)

climate_scenario_identity.name: climate_scenario_identity
climate_scenario_identity.value: "climate_scenario_units"."experiment" in ('historical','ssp245','ssp585') AND "climate_scenario_units"."variable" in ('tasmin','tasmax','tas','pr') AND "climate_scenario_units"."year" between 1950 and 2100 AND "climate_scenario_units"."tile_latitude" between -60 and 89 AND "climate_scenario_units"."tile_longitude" between -180 and 179 AND "climate_scenario_units"."model" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,39}$'

field_observation_state.name: field_observation_state
field_observation_state.value: "field_observations"."kind" in ('hls','smap','gpm') AND "field_observations"."status" in ('queued','submitted','completed','failed') AND "field_observations"."attempts" between 0 and 10 AND octet_length("field_observations"."request"::text)<=16384 AND ("field_observations"."status" in ('completed','failed')) = ("field_observations"."completed_at" is not null) AND ("field_observations"."status"='failed') = ("field_observations"."error_code" is not null) AND ("field_observations"."status"='completed') = ("field_observations"."result" is not null AND "field_observations"."result_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

field_extraction_state.name: field_extraction_state
field_extraction_state.value: "field_extractions"."kind" in ('terrain','ecostress','modis') AND "field_extractions"."status" in ('queued','submitted','completed','failed') AND "field_extractions"."attempts" between 0 and 10 AND octet_length("field_extractions"."request"::text)<=65536 AND ("field_extractions"."status" in ('completed','failed')) = ("field_extractions"."completed_at" is not null) AND ("field_extractions"."status"='failed') = ("field_extractions"."error_code" is not null) AND ("field_extractions"."status"='completed') = ("field_extractions"."result" is not null AND "field_extractions"."result_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

regional_gedi_biomass_value.name: regional_gedi_biomass_value
regional_gedi_biomass_value.value: "regional_gedi_biomass"."agbd_mg_ha" between 0 and 5000 AND ("regional_gedi_biomass"."se_mg_ha" is null OR "regional_gedi_biomass"."se_mg_ha" between 0 and 5000) AND "regional_gedi_biomass"."source_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "regional_gedi_biomass"."latitude_e3" between -90000 and 90000 AND "regional_gedi_biomass"."longitude_e3" between -180000 and 180000

regional_water_storage_value.name: regional_water_storage_value
regional_water_storage_value.value: "regional_water_storage"."month" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND "regional_water_storage"."lwe_cm" between -2000 and 2000 AND "regional_water_storage"."source_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "regional_water_storage"."latitude_e2" between -9000 and 9000 AND "regional_water_storage"."longitude_e2" between -18000 and 18000
